subject: Re: LiftBridge onramp — request for credit top-up + rate concession
messages:
From: Nicole Tran <nicole@liftbridge.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 May 2028 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding timeline and credits

Hannah —

Thanks for the quick demo yesterday. The team is excited about Redwood’s latency profile, but procurement pushed back on the initial budget. Two asks to see if we can move forward this week: 1) can you increase the free trial credits from $5k to $12k to cover the first two-week spike across a few models, and 2) can you offer a 20% discount on the first three months of usage (we expect to hit commit in month 4)?

If we can get those in writing I can fast-track approval and get signatures by next Friday. Attaching our brief SOW with expected timelines.

—Nicole
Nicole Tran
Head of Platform, LiftBridge Inc
nicole@liftbridge.com
(415) 555-0142
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Nicole Tran <nicole@liftbridge.com>
Date: Fri, 3 May 2028 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding timeline and credits

Nicole —

Appreciate the details and the SOW. I can meet the timeline but need to confirm internally on the credit top-up + the temporary discount. I’m looping in RevOps and my manager to expedite an exception review.

Proposed (internal):
- Free credits: $12,000 one-time top-up to cover onboarding spikes
- Promotional discount: 20% off metered usage for months 1–3, to be replaced by standard committed pricing thereafter
- Conditions: credits apply to hosted API only; usage above credits billed at discounted rate; commit by end of Q3 to convert to enterprise contract

I’ll share the official ask with leadership this morning.

Thanks,
Hannah
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 3 May 2028 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: FWD: LiftBridge onramp — request for credit top-up + rate concession

Marissa / Ben —

Forwarding LiftBridge’s ask (see below). Deal summary: LiftBridge (platform infra) is POC’ing multiple open models; ARR potential ~ $1.2m within 12 months if onboarding completes. They are under a hard procurement timeline — Nicole can sign if we put the credits and short-term discount in writing this week.

Requesting exec exception approval: $12k onboarding credit + 20% promo discount months 1–3. Attachments: SOW + pricing model.

Key risk controls I propose if you approve: credits scoped to hosted API only; credits expire 60 days after start of onboarding; discount applies only to metered usage below an agreed threshold (see spreadsheet). I’ve added HubSpot HS-98321 and an intended DocuSign envelope.

Can you confirm by EOD tomorrow? If we can get a one-line approval I’ll issue revised terms to Nicole and kick off DocuSign.

Thanks — Hannah
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 4 May 2028 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FWD: LiftBridge onramp — request for credit top-up + rate concession

Hannah —

I’m supportive of an exception here given the deal size and the strategic footprint (multi-team adoption). I have two asks before full sign-off: 1) cap the effective discount exposure to $40k (i.e., the 20% promo should not exceed $40k total ARR impact in months 1–3), and 2) include a clause that refunds/downgrades against the credit are not permitted once the DocuSign envelope is executed. Ben — please confirm finance ops is comfortable with the $12k credit and the proposed exposure cap.

Assuming Ben signs off, Marissa authorizes Hannah to proceed with the revised offer and attach the credit and discount terms to the DocuSign.

—Marissa Cole
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 4 May 2028 18:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FWD: LiftBridge onramp — request for credit top-up + rate concession

All —

Checked with finance. We can absorb the $12k onboarding credit under our accelerator budget and agree to the 20% promo constrained by Marissa’s $40k exposure cap. Confirming the operational controls: credits expire 60 days from the onboarding start date; credits block refunds; discounted rate applies to metered usage up to the agreed threshold in the pricing_model_liftbridge.xlsx attachment. After month 3 pricing reverts to standard list or agreed committed rate.

Ben Carter
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
